claims.claim: The cabinet matches the requested dimensions, named parts, joint, and place target.
claims.evidence: asset/model.urdf names robot drawer_cabinet, root carcass, drawer, handle, +X prismatic drawer_slide with limits 0 to 0.24 m, and fixed handle_mount. asset/asset.json maps drawer_opening to tray_floor. readings.json collision_boxes give a 0.30 m X by 0.42 m Y by 0.25 m Z carcass and 0.022 m legs; the declared 0.37 m total X extent includes the protruding handle. renders/front.png, side.png, top.png and iso.png show the requested single-drawer cabinet.

claims.claim: The tray has sufficient interior space and clearance within an open-front carcass.
claims.evidence: readings.json collision_boxes and probes/02_geometry.out: clear tray interior is 0.252 m X by 0.356 m Y by 0.160 m deep, exceeding 0.25 by 0.35 by 0.08 m. Closed rear, lateral, minimum bottom and top clearances are respectively 5, 4, 2 and 2 mm. The carcass has back, bottom, top and side boxes but no box filling the front opening or tray cavity.

claims.claim: Collision boxes follow the visual geometry without filling the accessible tray or omitting visible parts.
claims.evidence: All four renders show the expected panels, legs and projecting handle. probes/02_geometry.out checks the compiled OBJ meshes: all 1944 carcass, 1080 drawer and 775 handle vertices lie within their link's collision-box union; all 972, 540 and 1068 respective faces lie wholly within individual collision boxes. Every named box has corresponding visual geometry with matching bounds to six decimal places. Boxes conservatively approximate the visible panel bevels and rounded handle.

claims.claim: The drawer moves through its declared range without interpenetration and remains held at full extension.
claims.evidence: probes/01_operation.out reports no overlaps above 0.1 mm at 25 positions from q=0 to 0.24 m in 0.01 m increments, or after loaded closing and reopening. Released positions settle at q=0.0001276 and 0.2398704 m; drive transients overshoot by approximately 0.36 mm. Geometry gives positive lateral and vertical clearances throughout this straight translation. At full extension tray_floor spans X=0.113 to 0.385 m, retaining 0.037 m overlap with the carcass ending at X=0.15 m. A 20 N downward load for 30 frames leaves drawer pose [0.23987,0,0] with identity rotation, consistent with joint support.

claims.claim: The separate handle provides an accessible neck for grasping from above and pulling along +X.
claims.evidence: readings.json handles places the grasp at [0.165,0,0.136]. handle_neck is 40 mm long and 12 mm across, ending in a 35 mm knob; both meet the requested sizes and fit the 80 mm gripper opening. probes/02_geometry.out: a 20 mm wide finger centered at the grasp occupies X=0.155 to 0.175 m, beyond the carcass roof ending at X=0.150 and between the front panel ending at X=0.145 and knob beginning at X=0.185. This leaves an unobstructed approach from above; clearance increases with opening. asset/model.urdf fixes the handle to the drawer, and probes/01_operation.out verifies the associated slide can be driven open.

claims.claim: A 4 cm object placed at drawer_opening settles on the floor inside the rim and remains inside during closing and reopening.
claims.evidence: readings.json place_targets gives lip_local=[0.145,0,0.064]; at q=0.24 the prescribed placement X is 0.265 m. probes/01_operation.py drops a 0.04 m cube of mass 0.1 kg at that X,Y from Z=0.34. probes/01_operation.out: after 120 frames its center is [0.265,0,0.08394], with its bottom at 0.06394 m versus floor top 0.064 m, and four drawer contacts totaling 0.980 N. The cube lies inside the open tray interior X=0.123 to 0.375 and Y=-0.178 to 0.178 m. Its center remains at Z=0.08397 m after closing and reopening, with X=0.02478 and 0.26487 m respectively.

pairs.reason: The corresponding build/carcass.obj, build/drawer.obj, material/texture files and build/model.urdf in drawer_cabinet_a and drawer_cabinet_d1 are identical (including 24 cm drawer travel), while their build/handle.obj files differ only in face ordering, so geometry, appearance and interaction are unchanged.
